versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills for common tasks and new capabilities.
- Guides users through searching for skills with the Skills CLI (`npx skills`), including example queries and categories.
- Explains how to present skill options and assist with installation.
- Provides advice for situations when no relevant skills exist and encourages skill creation.
- Includes helpful tips for finding the most relevant skills efficiently.
